## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Scope check

- [ ] This does not require inventing food data client-side (no label→cooking-method table, no
      default portion weight) — see `AGENTS.md` for why that's a hard boundary.
- [ ] This does not require adding a new dependency to `PocketNutritionCore` (or if it does, I understand
      it needs maintainer sign-off, since the package is Foundation-only to stay Linux-testable).
- [ ] This is a client-side change, not something that belongs in `pocket-nutrition/knowledge`,
      `pocket-nutrition/api`, or another backend repo.
